SAP CAP Packages Mini Shai-Hulud

Target: sap-cap-js
Repository: https://github.com/cap-js/cds-dbs
Date: 2026-04-29 to 2026-04-30 (1 day)
Attribution: Advanced Persistent Threat
Component: Library
Language: JavaScript
Cause: CI/CD Exploit
Motive: Credential Theft
Transitive: false
Impact Type: Credential Theft
User Impact: 570000
Domain: npmjs.com (package host)
Artifact Type: source archive
Insertion Phase: distribution

Synopsis

In April 2026, the SAP Cloud Application Programming Model ecosystem was compromised when attackers exploited an npm OIDC configuration gap. They published backdoored versions of official packages like @cap-js/sqlite and @cap-js/postgres. A preinstall script used a downloaded Bun binary to execute a multi-stage credential stealer targeting SAP developers.

Compromised Versions

  • 2.2.2
  • 2.10.1
